'''JV-P12''' was a [[Color|blue]], box-shaped [[HVAC droid]] with two [[Limb|legs]]<ref name="SoloOG" /> that was forced to work in the criminal [[Pyke Syndicate]]'s [[spice]] [[Spice mines of Kessel|mines]] on the [[planet]] [[Kessel]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|Solo}}</ref> JV-P12 was freed from [[slavery]] when its [[restraining bolt]] was removed during a [[Raid on Kessel|slave revolt]] in the [[Mining|mines]] started by the [[droid]] [[L3-37]]. Once free, JV-P12 helped destroy the [[Pyke]]s' equipment by stomping on the top of one of the control panels in the mine's control center.<ref name="Solo" />

==Behind the scenes==
JV-P12 first appeared in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="Solo" /> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SoloOG" /> The character was performed by [[Hassan Taj]].<ref name="Insider 202">{{InsiderCite|202|Inside the Astromech}}</ref>
